expectedBehavior: Retention and confidence reflect observed customer exposure.

lessons.text: Do not average rates with unequal exposure denominators without justification.

observedBehavior: 0/1 and 13/16 periods produced an equal-period mean near 40%, despite pooled retention 13/17.
requiredFutureGates: Test tiny versus large cohorts, equal exposures, confidence floors and hidden-truth invariance; describe exposures as observations, not unique customers.
rootCause: Equal averaging of rates ignored substantially different denominators.
successfulCorrection: Pool retained and retention-eligible observations; require 20 exposure observations for Moderate confidence.
title: Product Fit gave equal weight to unequal exposures
unknownInformation: First observation and resolution dates not established by inspected evidence.
